name: io.github.wiiiktor/chopper
title: Chopper
description: Cuts the exact quotes that answer a question out of long text and reranks passages, in one pass.

environmentVariables.name: CHOPPER_VARIANT
environmentVariables.description: Model size and language: base (default), small, base-pl (Polish), mmbert-base-pl, small-pl

environmentVariables.name: CHOPPER_DEVICE
environmentVariables.description: auto (default), cpu or cuda; a GPU is recommended

environmentVariables.name: CHOPPER_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Directories chop_files may read (default: the home directory)

environmentVariables.name: CHOPPER_SNAP
environmentVariables.description: sentence (default: whole sentences), word (never cut inside a word) or none (raw)
